title: In 2024, a Minnesota dairy began turning manure from more than 2,000 cows into renewable gas
summary_full: In Minnesota, a pioneering dairy farm is transforming cow manure into ultra-low-carbon fuel for vehicles. This innovative facility processes thousands of gallons of manure each day, producing biomethane that enters interstate natural gas pipelines. By capturing methane—a significant greenhouse gas—before it escapes into the atmosphere, this project not only aids the environment but also provides a vital income stream for local dairy farmers.
